name: Character Tiers
summary: Tier Levels Typical Scope Tier 1 1-4 Districts, facilities, local threats and small warband operations. Tier 2 5-10 Planetary operations, elite enemies and major institutional conflict. Tier 3 11-16 System or subsector crises, powerful relics and strategic enemies. Tier 4 17-20 Sector-changing operations, armies, catastrophic Warp threats and legendary characters.
